test_cases.test_name: Functional Verification of X-bar/R Chart Creation and Nelson Rules
test_cases.objective: To verify that the SPC dashboard can correctly create X-bar/R control charts from a CSV file and accurately apply the vendor's standard Nelson rules for detecting out-of-control conditions.
prerequisites: SPC Dashboard software is installed and accessible
Test CSV file with sample subgroup data for X-bar/R chart is available
User account with appropriate permissions to create charts is configured

test_steps.action: Log into the SPC dashboard using valid credentials with chart creation permissions.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully authenticates and gains access to the main dashboard interface.

test_steps.action: Navigate to the chart creation module and select the option to create a new X-bar/R control chart.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the X-bar/R chart creation wizard or configuration interface.

test_steps.action: Upload the prepared test CSV file containing subgroup data using the standard import function.
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully imports the CSV data and displays a preview of the dataset.

test_steps.action: Configure the chart parameters (subgroup size, specification limits) and enable all vendor standard Nelson rules.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the configuration and displays the configured parameters.

test_steps.action: Generate the X-bar/R control chart and verify the application of Nelson rules.
test_steps.expected_result: System renders the X-bar/R chart with control limits and correctly flags any points violating Nelson rules.
data_to_capture: Record of any Nelson rule violations detected

acceptance_criteria: X-bar/R chart is generated successfully from CSV input data
Vendor standard Nelson rules are correctly applied and visible on the chart
Control limits are calculated accurately based on the provided data
Any out-of-control conditions are properly flagged according to Nelson rules
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and electronic signatures
ICH Q7 for Good Manufacturing Practice
FDA Guidance for Industry - Process Validation: General Principles and Practices
data_integrity_requirements: Chart configuration settings must be retained as controlled records
Data import must maintain accuracy and completeness from source CSV
urs_requirements: URS-020-001: Users shall create X-bar/R and p-charts from CSV inputs
URS-020-002: Users shall apply vendor's standard Nelson rules
URS-020-008: Retain chart configurations as controlled records

test_cases.test_name: Performance Verification of Data Loading and Chart Rendering
test_cases.objective: To verify that the SPC dashboard meets performance requirements for loading large datasets and rendering charts within specified time limits.
prerequisites: SPC Dashboard software is installed on supported hardware
Test CSV file with 100,000+ data points is prepared
Stopwatch or timing tool is available for performance measurement

test_steps.action: Log into the SPC dashboard and navigate to the data import functionality.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully accesses the data import module.

test_steps.action: Initiate the import of the large test CSV file containing 100,000+ data points and start timing.
test_steps.expected_result: System begins processing the CSV file import.

test_steps.action: Monitor the import process until completion and record the total load time.
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully loads all 100,000+ data points into the database.

test_steps.action: Create a control chart using the loaded dataset and apply standard filters.
test_steps.expected_result: System prepares the chart configuration with the large dataset.

test_steps.action: Initiate chart rendering and measure the time until complete display.
test_steps.expected_result: System renders the control chart with all data points visible.

test_steps.action: Apply filter changes to the chart and measure the re-rendering time.
test_steps.expected_result: System quickly re-renders the chart with the applied filters.

acceptance_criteria: 100,000+ data points load in less than 5 seconds on supported hardware
Charts render completely in less than 2 seconds after initial configuration
Chart re-rendering after filter changes completes in less than 2 seconds
System remains responsive during all performance testing operations
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 for system performance and reliability
GAMP 5 guidelines for verification of commercial software
data_integrity_requirements: All 100,000+ data points must be accurately loaded without data loss
Chart rendering must maintain data accuracy and statistical integrity
urs_requirements: URS-020-010: Load 100k data points in < 5 seconds on supported hardware
URS-020-011: Render charts in < 2 seconds after filter changes

test_cases.test_name: ODBC Data Import and Chart Generation Verification
test_cases.objective: To verify that the SPC dashboard can successfully import data from an ODBC data source and generate standard control charts (X-bar/R and p-charts) from the imported dataset.
prerequisites: OQ-001 Installation completed successfully
ODBC data source configured and accessible
Valid test dataset available in the ODBC source
User with appropriate permissions is logged in

test_steps.action: Navigate to the data import section and select the ODBC connection option.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the ODBC connection configuration dialog.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the ODBC configuration dialog

test_steps.action: Configure the connection using the pre-defined ODBC DSN and execute the data import.
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully connects to the data source and displays a preview of the available data.

test_steps.action: Select a dataset containing variable and attribute data and confirm the import.
test_steps.expected_result: System imports the data and displays a confirmation message. The dataset appears in the dashboard's data library.

test_steps.action: Create a new X-bar/R chart using the imported ODBC data.
test_steps.expected_result: System generates the X-bar and R charts correctly based on the selected data columns.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the generated X-bar/R chart

test_steps.action: Create a new p-chart using attribute data from the same imported dataset.
test_steps.expected_result: System generates the p-chart correctly, calculating proportions from the attribute data.

acceptance_criteria: ODBC data import completes without errors
Imported data is accurately reflected in the dashboard data library
X-bar/R and p-charts are generated correctly from the ODBC data source
Chart calculations match expected values from the source data
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; demonstrates use of validated data sources
GMP principles for data integrity and traceability
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be transferred completely and accurately from the ODBC source
No data corruption or alteration during the import process
Audit trail (if available) must record the data import event

test_cases.test_name: Scheduled Report Generation and Email Distribution Test
test_cases.objective: To verify that the vendor's built-in scheduler can successfully generate and email PDF/CSV reports according to a predefined schedule.
prerequisites: OQ-001 Installation completed successfully
A configured chart or report is saved
Email server settings are configured in the system
A valid recipient email address is configured

test_steps.action: Navigate to the scheduling module and create a new scheduled task for a saved chart report.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the scheduler configuration interface.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the scheduler configuration screen

test_steps.action: Configure the task to generate a PDF report and set the schedule to run immediately or within a short timeframe.
test_steps.expected_result: Scheduler accepts the configuration and saves the scheduled task.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the saved task configuration

test_steps.action: Configure the email distribution list for the report and set the subject/body template.
test_steps.expected_result: Email settings are saved successfully with the scheduled task.

test_steps.action: Wait for the scheduled time to elapse and verify the task execution in the scheduler log.
test_steps.expected_result: Scheduler log indicates the task ran successfully and the report was generated.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the scheduler execution log

test_steps.action: Check the recipient's email inbox for the delivered report attachment.
test_steps.expected_result: Email is received containing the correct PDF/CSV report attachment.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the received email with attachment

test_steps.action: Verify the content and format of the received report matches the original chart.
test_steps.expected_result: The exported report accurately represents the chart data and format.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the opened report for content verification

acceptance_criteria: Scheduled task is created and saved without error
Task executes automatically at the scheduled time
Report is generated in the correct format (PDF/CSV)
Email is successfully sent to the designated recipients
Report content is accurate and complete
regulatory_basis: GMP requirements for automated reporting and data distribution
21 CFR Part 11 - electronic signatures and records for automated processes
data_integrity_requirements: Scheduled reports must be identical to manually generated reports
Email distribution must be complete and accurate
Scheduler must maintain an execution log for traceability

test_cases.test_name: ODBC Data Source Integration and Import Verification
test_cases.objective: To verify that the SPC dashboard can successfully connect to and import data from a configured ODBC data source using the vendor's standard connectors.
prerequisites: OQ-001 Installation Verification completed successfully
A test database with a known schema and sample QC data is available
A valid ODBC data source name (DSN) is configured on the test machine
Valid database credentials are available

test_steps.action: Launch the SPC dashboard and navigate to the data import section.
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard loads successfully and data import options are accessible.

test_steps.action: Select the ODBC connection option and choose the pre-configured test DSN from the list.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the list of available ODBC data sources; the test DSN is selectable.

test_steps.action: Enter valid credentials and attempt to connect to the database.
test_steps.expected_result: Connection is established successfully without errors.

test_steps.action: Select a known table or view from the database schema containing QC data.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the database schema and allows selection of the target table.

test_steps.action: Map the database columns to the required SPC chart fields and initiate the data import.
test_steps.expected_result: Data is imported successfully, and a confirmation message is displayed.

test_steps.action: Verify the imported data by comparing a sample of records in the dashboard with the source database.
test_steps.expected_result: Imported data matches the source data exactly, confirming data integrity.

acceptance_criteria: The system establishes a connection to the ODBC data source without errors.
The system successfully imports data from the specified database table.
All imported data is accurate and complete when compared to the source.
The import process completes within the performance requirements for data loading.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Requirements for electronic records and trusted data sources.
GMP principles ensuring data integrity during transfer from source systems.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be transferred completely and accurately from the source database.
The import process must not alter or corrupt the original data values.
Audit trail (if available) should record the data source and import timestamp.
urs_requirements: URS-020-012: Import data from CSV and ODBC connections using standard connectors.

test_cases.test_name: Scheduled Report Generation and Email Distribution
test_cases.objective: To verify that the vendor's built-in scheduler can automatically generate and email PDF/CSV reports according to a predefined schedule.
prerequisites: OQ-002 Basic Chart Creation completed successfully
A valid email server configuration is set up in the dashboard
A test email recipient address is configured
A sample chart configuration is saved and ready for reporting

test_steps.action: Navigate to the scheduling module within the SPC dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: Scheduling interface is accessible and functional.

test_steps.action: Create a new scheduled report task, selecting a pre-configured X-bar/R chart.
test_steps.expected_result: System allows creation of a new scheduled task with chart selection.

test_steps.action: Configure the schedule to run immediately or within a short timeframe for testing.
test_steps.expected_result: Schedule is accepted by the system without validation errors.

test_steps.action: Set the output format to PDF and CSV, and specify the test email recipient.
test_steps.expected_result: Output formats and recipient are correctly configured.

test_steps.action: Save the scheduled task and verify it appears in the task list as active.
test_steps.expected_result: Task is saved successfully and appears in the active tasks list.

test_steps.action: Wait for the scheduled time and verify the report generation and email dispatch.
test_steps.expected_result: Report is generated and email is sent to the recipient at the scheduled time.

test_steps.action: Verify the received email contains the correct attachments and report content.
test_steps.expected_result: Email contains PDF and CSV attachments with accurate chart data.

acceptance_criteria: The scheduler successfully triggers the report generation at the specified time.
Reports are generated in both PDF and CSV formats as configured.
The system sends the email with correct attachments to the specified recipient.
The generated reports contain accurate and complete data from the selected chart.
regulatory_basis: GMP requirements for automated reporting and data distribution.
21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic records and signatures for automated processes.
data_integrity_requirements: Scheduled reports must accurately reflect the current chart data and configuration.
The email distribution process must not alter the report content or format.
The scheduler should maintain a log of execution attempts and outcomes.
urs_requirements: URS-020-003: The system shall provide vendor standard export to PDF and CSV.
URS-020-006: The system shall support scheduled report emails using vendor scheduler.
related_tests: OQ-002: Basic Chart Creation and Nelson Rules Application
